Components / Reasoning

Agent

The identity/run surface: the persona molecule in the header plus a run-state badge and the thumb-reachable Start/Pause/Stop control bar the web config card never had. The run is the caller's — controlled status, reported verbs, dead bar when no handler is wired. The web card's instructions/tools/output body is deferred to its own surfaces.

  • v0.2.1
  • component
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/agent.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/agent.json

Props

NameTypeDefaultDescription
runStatusAgentRunStatus | undefined'idle'Controlled run state. The caller owns the run — this only mirrors it.
onRunAction((action: AgentRunAction) => void) | undefined—Fires on Start / Pause / Stop. Omit it and the control bar never renders.

Theming

Themed via bg-muted, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground.

Usage

(o) => ( <Agent runStatus={(o.runStatus as 'idle' | 'running' | 'paused' | 'error' | 'done') ?? 'running'} onRunAction={() => {}} > <AgentHeader name="Registry Porter" description="Installs the 56-item set into consumer apps" avatarUri={AVATAR_URI} /> <AgentContent> <Text className="text-sm text-muted-foreground"> Run 12 · installing conversation.json through the RNR CLI </Text> </AgentContent> <AgentActions /> </Agent> )
